title: The six-dimensional cross-polytope has signaling dimension three
description: Unrefereed computer-assisted candidate. The six-dimensional cross-polytope has signaling dimension three in the full affine model with free shared randomness. Complete support classification covers 133130 rooted representatives and retains 217 valid records. Rational simulator certificates and a separate orbit audit establish the finite computational obligations. The package additionally provides 49 full signed-cube symmetry classes, of which 28 require the nontrivial certificates. The lower bound, finite criterion, small-facet construction and generic enumeration framework are credited prior work. No formal verification, external peer review or unaffiliated reproduction is claimed. Original research content is CC0-1.0; original code is MIT. See the component-level licence map.
